name: ScaleGrid
description_en:
ScaleGrid manages several database engines through dedicated hosting and bring-your-own-cloud deployments. It is an operations service around the selected engine, cloud and topology, rather than a single interchangeable database product. The relevant configuration determines access, replicas, backups and the cost boundary.

This profile follows the official PostgreSQL documentation to examine a proposed deployment, application connection and recovery exercise. It separates included infrastructure from management-only fees and keeps older account/version guidance qualified. No cloud account, invitation, cluster, firewall rule or restore was operated.
description_zh:
ScaleGrid 通过专用主机及自带云账户部署管理多种数据库引擎。它是围绕所选引擎、云及拓扑的运维服务，不是一个可随意互换的单一数据库产品。具体配置决定访问、复制、备份及费用边界。

本文按官方 PostgreSQL 文档评估拟建部署、应用连接及恢复演练，区分包含基础设施的收费与仅管理费，并限定旧账户／版本指南的适用范围。本次未操作云账户、邀请、集群、防火墙规则或恢复。

review_notes: Original AI research draft based on the cited public official pages; no publication, price approval, independent review or product test is implied.
Earlier third-party feature and price claims are retained only in discovery provenance, not as current product evidence.

sections.title_en: Hosting choice changes the bill and responsibilities
sections.title_zh: 主机方式改变账单及责任
sections.en: Dedicated hosting pricing includes machine, disk and network resources, whereas BYOC lists a management charge and leaves cloud infrastructure billing with the customer. PostgreSQL setup guides distinguish these paths before provisioning. Confirm the cloud, region, engine version and support tier for the actual quote; an older documentation version list is not proof of current patch support. No account or resource was created.
sections.zh: 专用主机价格包含机器、磁盘及网络资源，BYOC 列出管理费，云基础设施仍由客户另付。PostgreSQL 设置指南在创建前区分两条路径。实际报价需明确云、区域、引擎版本及支持层级，旧文档版本清单不证明当前补丁支持。本次未创建账户或资源。

sections.title_en: Replica counts and durability settings need separate decisions
sections.title_zh: 副本数量与持久性设置需分别选择
sections.en: The BYOC guide distinguishes standalone and replicated clusters, including two data nodes plus a voter versus three data nodes. A voter does not make a third data copy. Synchronous and asynchronous replication choices affect durability tradeoffs. The guide also presents SSL, disk encryption and pooling as choices, with a mandatory firewall for its internet-exposed path. Review the real network and failure design rather than assuming every BYOC deployment is private or identically protected.
sections.zh: BYOC 指南区分单节点与复制集群，包括两数据节点加投票节点、或三数据节点；投票节点不代表第三份数据。同步／异步复制也影响持久性取舍。指南将 SSL、磁盘加密及连接池列为选项，并为该公网路径要求防火墙。应核对真实网络及故障设计，不能假定所有 BYOC 都默认私有或保护相同。

sections.title_en: Primary routing is different from distributing reads
sections.title_zh: 主库路由不同于分散读取
sections.en: The connection guide describes a master DNS name that follows the primary and separate replica addresses for read-only use. Generic replica DNS returns an IP set; it is not evidence that every client balances each query. Verify driver behavior, TLS settings and failover reconnection with an application account. Connection templates contain password placeholders and should not be treated as a ready production configuration.
sections.zh: 连接指南描述跟随主库的 master DNS，以及供只读使用的副本地址。通用副本 DNS 返回 IP 集合，不证明每个客户端逐查询均衡。应使用应用账户核对驱动行为、TLS 设置及故障后重连。连接模板包含密码占位符，不是可直接使用的生产配置。

sections.title_en: A snapshot has engine and cloud boundaries
sections.title_zh: 快照受引擎及云方式约束
sections.en: PostgreSQL backups cover the instance’s databases, users and settings. The page documents cloud-specific snapshot methods, with pg_basebackup for DigitalOcean, and describes an encrypted-backup restore constraint tied to the source machines. This is not an arbitrary-time recovery guarantee. Confirm the chosen cloud’s restore target, encryption handling and recovery objective before adopting the service. No snapshot or recovery result was observed.
sections.zh: PostgreSQL 备份覆盖实例数据库、用户及设置。页面列出各云快照方式，其中 DigitalOcean 使用 pg_basebackup，并说明加密备份恢复与源机器相关的限制。这不等于任意时间点恢复保证。采用服务前应确认所选云的恢复目标、加密处理及恢复目标，本次未观察快照或恢复结果。

sections.title_en: Inspecting a backup creates another billed deployment
sections.title_zh: 检查备份会创建另一个计费部署
sections.en: Peek at Backup creates a new standalone server from the selected backup without replacing the main deployment. Standard pricing applies to that server. A partial recovery still requires inspecting the recovered data and deliberately exporting/reloading selected objects with awareness of the live schema. Budget the temporary resource and validate dependencies before reinserting anything; the peek itself is not an automatic safe merge into current data.
sections.zh: Peek at Backup 从所选备份创建新独立服务器，不替换主部署；该服务器适用标准价格。局部恢复仍需检查恢复数据，并理解在线 schema 后主动导出／导入所选对象。应为临时资源预算，回填前验证依赖；Peek 本身不是向当前数据自动安全合并。

sections.title_en: Team access guidance includes a legacy account caveat
sections.title_zh: 团队访问指南包含旧账户条件
sections.en: Team accounts provide shared management access. However, the cited guide tells existing invitees to remove deployments and contact support about their existing tenant before joining. That destructive legacy prerequisite needs current provider clarification; it should not become routine onboarding advice. Confirm supported account migration and actual role permissions without deleting resources or sending an invitation during evaluation.
sections.zh: 团队账户提供共享管理访问，但引用指南要求已有账户的受邀者先删除部署，再联系支持处理原租户。这项旧的破坏性前提需向当前服务方确认，不应成为常规入组建议。评估时需确认受支持账户迁移及实际角色权限，无需删除资源或发送邀请。

sections.title_en: Support and nonproduction resources can add charges
sections.title_zh: 支持及非生产资源可能另收费
sections.en: The pricing page offers a seven-day trial and included Starter support. Standard support is 20% of monthly contract value with a $70/month minimum; Production is 30% with a $100 minimum. Dedicated plans include up to five backups, with more available for an extra fee. The FAQ applies standard pricing to staging. Cluster amounts were not exposed by the public configurator, so this record does not invent a normalized monthly deployment price.
sections.zh: 定价页提供七天试用及包含的 Starter 支持。Standard 支持为月合同额 20%、最低每月 $70，Production 为 30%、最低 $100。专用方案最多包含五份备份，额外备份另收费。FAQ 对 staging 采用标准价格。公开配置器未显示集群金额，因此本文不编造归一化部署月费。
